title: Pre-registered interpretation rule for the nested-CV SPK-LFP re-run
why: The fixed-alpha pilot produced a uniform negative delta_pred whose sign has at least two competing explanations. Committing the interpretation mapping BEFORE seeing the nested results prevents reading the outcome post hoc. The mapping below is Hamm's, recorded verbatim in structure.
primary_estimator: nested -- past-LFP lag features, Ridge alpha tuned by LOO-GCV inside each training fold, M2 and M3 tuned independently. Outer held-out trials never participate in selecting alpha.

null_is_not_zero.statement: Adding uninformative features costs held-out R^2, so the null floor for delta_pred lies BELOW zero and its depth scales with 1/n.
null_is_not_zero.consequence: Detection is defined against the PERMUTED arm, not against zero.
null_is_not_zero.rule: A cell counts as detected when its pooled delta exceeds the 95th percentile of the permuted arm's delta within the same trial-count stratum.
null_is_not_zero.synthetic_receipt: At n=137 the permuted arm gave delta = -0.0081 and the beta=0 injection gave -0.0141, both far below zero, while at n=820 both were ~-0.001 -- confirming the floor exists and is n-dependent.

falsifier: This plan is closed when every arm in the re-run matrix has reported a delta distribution and the decision table below resolves to exactly one row.

decision_table.condition: delta_nested ~ 0 (at the permuted floor) AND injection detected at plausible beta
decision_table.conclusion: Informative biological null at detectable effect sizes.
decision_table.scope_limit: One session, these trial counts, this injection geometry.

decision_table.conclusion: Underpowered / inconclusive. NOT a biological null.
decision_table.scope_limit: Reporting this as an absence of effect would be the error the omission-statistics skill names explicitly.

decision_table.conclusion: Candidate incremental predictive dependence. Still not causal, still not directional.
Contemporaneous association without detectable past dependence.
decision_table.scope_limit: The concurrent arm shares instantaneous common drive with firing and can carry spike contamination, so it cannot license a past-dependence claim in either direction.

reported_quantities: per-fold R^2 for M2 and M3, per-fold delta, per-fold selected alpha
median/mean fold delta, dispersion, and pooled out-of-fold delta
minimum injected beta reaching ~80% detection, per trial-count stratum
delta_nested MINUS delta_permuted as the n-corrected contrast (this is what makes the omission vs matched-empty comparison interpretable, since the raw comparison is confounded by trial count)
known_caveats_registered_in_advance: Injection uses equal weights across the four lag intervals -- the most detectable geometry. Reported detection rates are therefore an UPPER BOUND on sensitivity, not a typical case.
The injected signal is added to the observed target and M2 is refit on it, so any part of the injected signal already predictable from spike history is correctly not credited as incremental.
Per-fold R^2 uses the training fold's mean as baseline; both models share it within a fold so it cancels in delta_k. Pooled OOF R^2 uses the global mean, for comparability with the fixed-alpha run.
One session. No corpus-level or population claim follows from it; the session is the inferential unit and n_sessions = 1.
No causal or directional language is admissible on any outcome -- causal-identification-branch-seal-20260828.json is CONFIRMED closed.
